decisions.title: Coverage representation in PublicLensProjection
decisions.context: #304 records a 0–100 versus 0–1 mismatch and asks the producer to publish canonical semantics.
decisions.recommendation: Export counts plus coverageRatio in [0,1] and a versioned coverageMethodId. Do not retain an ambiguous coverageScore.

options.label: Counts + ratio + method ID
options.description: Self-describing, testable and resistant to consumer guessing.

options.label: Keep 0–100 percent
options.description: Minimal source change, but retains a generic score name and consumer conversion.

options.label: Counts only
options.description: Avoids formula semantics but makes common rendering needlessly repetitive.

decisions.title: ResearchFinding repair strategy
decisions.context: Issues #318, #324–#326 are robustness defects; #319–#321 and #327 alter published semantics.
decisions.recommendation: Land one v1 robustness PR with no semantic reinterpretation, then publish a v2 ADR and implementation for gate semantics.

options.label: v1 hardening + v2 semantics
options.description: Protects consumers without silently changing a published contract.

options.label: Patch everything in v1
options.description: Fastest, but violates the stated versioning boundary and breaks hashes/meaning.

options.label: Wait and fix only in v2
options.description: Clean versioning, but leaves preventable parser/validation crashes in v1.

decisions.title: Gate representation
decisions.context: ResearchFinding v1 exports seven gates but carries evidence sufficient to derive only three.
decisions.recommendation: In v2 every gate carries a rule reference and supporting evidence; omit or mark not-applicable when evidence is absent. Never accept a free-floating verdict.

options.label: Evidence-bearing gates
options.description: Makes gate integrity mechanically inspectable across producers.

options.label: Export only the three derivable gates
options.description: Smaller contract, but loses useful decision context.

options.label: Keep all with disclosure
options.description: Preserves information but leaves semantic integrity outside validation.

decisions.title: False-alert improvement rule
decisions.context: MethodTrialView uses a preregistered 20% improvement threshold; ResearchFinding v1 currently treats any decrease as passing.
decisions.recommendation: Use the preregistered 20% rule for the decision gate. Add a separately named descriptive any-reduction indicator only if a consumer needs it.

options.label: Use preregistered 20% gate
options.description: Keeps projection faithful to the source decision contract.

options.label: Use any reduction
options.description: Intuitive label, but misprojects the trial decision.

options.label: Export both under distinct codes
options.description: Useful if consumers need both; adds contract surface and explanation burden.

decisions.title: Outcome and limitation wording
decisions.context: The model-promotion copy is reject-specific, and thresholds_nonviable can contradict passing selection gates.
decisions.recommendation: Use outcome-neutral non-promotion wording and derive threshold limitations from selection evidence rather than accepting them independently.

options.label: Neutral copy + derived limitations
options.description: Removes contradictions and keeps safety statements on every outcome.

options.label: Restrict text by outcome
options.description: Mechanically simple, but benchmarked results lose an important non-promotion disclaimer.

decisions.title: Contract source of truth
decisions.context: Rules, registries, JSON Schema, README tables and fixtures can drift across Product, Lab and CommitAtlas.
decisions.recommendation: Own one executable TypeScript registry in Product and generate schema, registry docs and conformance fixtures from it.

options.label: Product registry + code generation
options.description: One authority, deterministic outputs and cross-repo vectors.

options.label: JSON Schema first
options.description: Portable, but cannot express all semantic rules and makes runtime rules secondary.

options.label: Keep parallel hand-maintained forms
options.description: Flexible but perpetuates drift and review cost.

decisions.title: Lens extension model
decisions.context: The product needs more analyses, but an early third-party plugin runtime would expand the attack and compatibility surface.
decisions.recommendation: Introduce a compile-time LensDefinition registry first. Consider external plugins only after several internally stable lenses expose a real common shape.

options.label: Compile-time LensDefinition
options.description: Reusable architecture with ordinary type checking and no new trust boundary.

options.label: Runtime plugin API now
options.description: Highly extensible, but premature and security-heavy.

options.label: Keep each lens bespoke
options.description: Fast for one lens, but repeats evidence, abstention and projection machinery.
